name: Altass Motors
headline: Car Export Dealership In Dubai Export-Ready Cars in Dubai
lede: Altass Motors sells export-ready cars in Dubai. We prepare the UAE export paperwork and deliver to the port, where the shipping company you appoint takes over.
about: Shipping itself is not ours to arrange. You appoint the shipping company. They book the vessel or the container, quote the freight, and arrange insurance if you want it. Clearing the car through customs in your country is handled by your shipping company and your customs broker, not by us. We do not book freight, we do not quote it, we do not track the car after the port, and we do not recommend agents.

Most of the export files we prepare are for buyers in Africa, the Middle East, Eastern Europe and parts of Asia, particularly Ghana, Nigeria, Jordan, Georgia and Iraq. We prepare the UAE-side paperwork for those markets. We do not ship the car and we do not clear it at the destination, so the route it takes and the customs process at the other end are handled by your shipping company and your customs broker.
